Chef Robotics is bringing AI into the physical world, starting with one of the world’s largest industries: food manufacturing.

Food production faces one of the most severe labor shortages in the US, with more than 1 million open jobs today and demand continuing to grow. Our robots help manufacturers automate repetitive food-preparation and assembly tasks so they can increase throughput, improve consistency, and keep production onshore.

Today, Chef robots operate in production facilities across North America and Europe, serving customers including Amy’s Kitchen, gategroup, and CookUnity. Our robots have made over 100 million servings in production, creating the world’s largest proprietary dataset for AI-powered manipulation of deformable food. Every meal our robots produce makes the system smarter.

Backed by leading investors including Avataar Ventures, Construct Capital, Bloomberg Beta, Promus Ventures, and Kleiner Perkins, we’re scaling rapidly with a robotics-as-a-service (RaaS) model and long-term customer partnerships. Our team includes engineers and leaders from Google, Cruise, Tesla, Amazon Robotics, Dexterity, Bear Robotics, Saildrone, and Zoox, united by a mission to build intelligent machines that solve meaningful problems in the real world.

If you’re excited about solving hard problems, creating real customer impact, and shipping systems that operate in production every day, not just in the lab, you’ll feel at home at Chef.

About The Role

As a Key Account Executive, you will own the full sales cycle, from outbound discovery and demos to complex negotiations and closing. You will be a foundational member of our enterprise team, shaping how enterprise sales are built at Chef Robotics.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage multi-stakeholder buying processes within large-scale food manufacturing and contract manufacturing firms.
  • Drive enterprise-grade deals with an average contract value (ACV) ranging from $100K to $1M.
  • Own the end-to-end sales process, including discovery, demos, and proposals, with the support of a strong SDR and technical team.
  • As an early member of the enterprise team, you will help define the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and the future of our sales motion.

Who You Are:

  • You have a proven track record of navigating complex organizations and closing deals that move the needle for the business.
  • You thrive in high-stakes environments and are motivated by closing six-figure enterprise deals.
  • You are excited by the prospect of deploying AI and robotics to solve critical labor challenges in the food industry.
  • You enjoy the "inflection point" stage of a startup—where the product is proven, but there is still significant room to shape the direction of the company.

Why Join Us Now?

  • We are in a sector that has been slow to adopt automation but is now moving fast.
  • Join a team heading into a Series B with a pipeline that is already outgrowing our current capacity.

ABOUT VICTORY LIVE
Victory Live is a private equity backed technology company aimed at maximizing distribution and yield for live event ticket inventory. We provide an end-to-end software platform for the live ticketing industry, managing thousands of sports, theater, and live music event tickets on behalf of artists, promoters, teams, venues, and professional resellers. Victory Live’s comprehensive offerings include an established B2B marketplace, along with both a full-service and an automated SaaS platform to handle all elements of the ticket sales lifecycle, from ingestion to sales fulfillment.

THE POSITION
Victory Live is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to own the technologies and processes that power our B2B marketplace on C# and .NET. You'll ship features across several business-critical services, retire technical debt, and set the standards other engineers build against. This is a chance to shape one of our main revenue engines at a premier live event ticketing company.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate across teams to influence engineering work, ensuring decisions align with divisional strategy.
  • Drive large-scale technical initiatives in our .NET services, solving highly complex problems and shipping scalable, secure solutions.
  • Provide guidance and support to engineers, helping them grow and work through hard technical problems.
  • Work with Architects to design and implement system-level solutions within company standards.
  • Define and promote engineering best practices across teams, from test coverage to service boundaries.
  • Identify and pay down technical debt to keep our .NET services maintainable.
  • Hold the team's code to a high bar through rigorous review, consistent with our quality program.
  • Write high-quality code yourself on the most complex and critical work.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 10+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in C# and .NET.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining high-throughput backend services and APIs at scale.
  • Deep understanding of software engineering best practices.
  • Familiarity with the rest of our stack: Entity Framework Core, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Redis, MSSQL Server, Datadog, Grafana, Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, GitHub.
  • Familiarity with Azure and AWS services.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Knowledge of live ticket sales or experience working within a fast-paced industry.
  • Mentorship and leadership experience guiding onshore and offshore teams.
  • Genuine interest in growing the engineers around you and shaping team culture, even without a formal management track.

WHY VICTORY LIVE

  • You'll build the infrastructure live events run on; millions of tickets, hundreds of venues, many of the largest teams and events in the world.
  • A lean team where decisions move fast and your code reaches real fans, often the same week.
  • Every release has stakes. Every improvement is felt.
  • High expectations, low tolerance for politics, and a culture built on writing well and shipping with care.

OUR VALUES
We build the systems that power live event ticketing, and we hold a high bar for how we do it. Four principles run through everything:

  • Quality of life. Sustainable processes over heroics. Nobody should be a single point of failure, and nobody should be afraid to take a vacation.
  • Quality of code. Clarity over cleverness. If a teammate needs a long explanation to follow your code, it needs simplifying. Tests prove your work; they aren't optional.
  • Protection of production. Every change is reviewed, tested, and observable. We build with monitoring in mind from day one so we find problems before our users do.
  • Shared knowledge. We work across time zones, so we communicate in the open. Questions go in channels, not DMs, and one answer becomes shared knowledge.

ENGINEERING PRINCIPLES
We are an AI-native engineering team. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • AI-assisted engineering. Every engineer uses Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, and agentic tooling as a routine part of their workflow.
  • Async-first. Most decisions happen in writing through Jira, Confluence, PR descriptions, design docs. We over-communicate on changes and under-communicate on noise.
  • Ownership mindset. Engineers are responsible for what they write and no code reaches production without review. Reviewers are co-owners.
  • Observability is part of "done." If the on-call engineer can't understand a system without reading source, more logging, metrics, and dashboards are needed.
  • Preservation of quality of code and life. We write code that is clean, tested, and maintainable so it serves us well over time, and we build sustainable processes so no one burns out or becomes a single point of failure.
  • Shared knowledge and continued education. We grow as a team by learning from each other through reviews, documentation, and collaboration.

OUR STACK & WAYS OF WORKING

  • C# and .NET power our B2B marketplace, distribution integrations, and partner-facing APIs
  • Web & mobile clients, REST APIs, microservices
  • Frameworks and tools: .NET, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, xUnit
  • Data: MSSQL Server, Postgres, Redis
  • Cloud & infra: Azure, AWS, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
  • AI tooling: Anthropic / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, in-house agentic workflows
  • Observability: Datadog, Grafana, Elastic/Kibana, OpsGenie
  • Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Slack, Miro
  • Async-first, agile cadences, distributed onshore + offshore teams

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Comprehensive medical coverage
  • 100% employer-paid dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • Employee wellness and professional development opportunities

Victory Live is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, Veteran status, or another other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law.

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.

  • Drive Partner Success & Value: Focus heavily on customer success over pure sales; help partners maximize the full value of Fresha, naturally driving monetization and retention.

  • Identify, document, and track defects with the detail and reproducibility engineers actually need to fix them quickly.

Qualifications

    (preferred), Cypress, or Selenium, and JavaScript/TypeScript (preferred).
  • Proven ability to build automation frameworks from scratch — you've designed one and can describe the architectural decisions you made, not just maintained one.
  • Extensive, current usage of Claude Code or Cowork (or equivalent agentic coding tools) for real automation work — generating tests, refactoring suites, debugging failures. This is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have. Be ready to talk specifics.
  • Solid grounding in manual testing fundamentals: test case design, exploratory testing, regression, and defect reporting.
  • A sharp eye for detail and a genuine instinct for how things break.
  • Clear communication and the ability to collaborate across engineering and product.
  • A bias toward ownership — you see quality as your responsibility, not someone else's gate to clear.

iRESTORE is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer brand in the beauty and wellness space, focused on helping customers restore confidence through safe, effective, and technology-led solutions for hair regrowth, skin, and body care.

  • Esquire highlighted iRestore’s innovation in the red light therapy and wellness space

  • Innerbody Research published an in-depth review of the iRestore system and user experience

As we scale into a global wellness brand, we are focused on strengthening the customer journey across every touchpoint. By combining data, experimentation, creative strategy, and continuous optimization, we are building an in-house creative engine to support the next phase of customer acquisition, brand growth, and performance marketing. If you’re excited about joining a fast-growing brand making an impact in the wellness and technology space, we’d love to hear from you!

Position Overview

iRESTORE is seeking a Manager, Paid Social to build and scale paid acquisition for our Subscriptions and Consumables product categories across Meta, TikTok, Google, YouTube, and emerging platforms. We’re looking for someone with strong DTC experience, creative instincts, and a clear understanding of how social content and platform strategy intersect to drive business results. The right candidate is highly analytical, resourceful, and excited to develop the channel strategy, campaign structure, creative testing roadmap, and measurement approach from the ground up. This is a hands-on, in-platform role for someone who can identify early signals, act quickly on learnings, and create a repeatable path to growth. This role reports to the VP of Growth Marketing and collaborates closely with our Senior Performance Creative Manager, internal creative teams, and external agency partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and scale paid acquisition for our Subscriptions and Consumables product categories across Meta, TikTok, Google, YouTube, and emerging platforms.
  • Own channel strategy, campaign setup, budget pacing, and day-to-day optimization against revenue, ROAS, CAC, traffic, CPC, and conversion goals.
  • Develop a testing roadmap across audiences, bidding, campaign structure, creative, landing pages, and new in-platform opportunities.
  • Partner with our Senior Performance Creative Manager, internal creative teams, and agency partners to turn performance insights into new concepts and creative iterations.
  • Identify opportunities across the post-click journey and collaborate with Digital Product on landing-page and conversion testing.
  • Build weekly and monthly forecasts, communicate performance clearly, and recommend budget or strategy shifts based on results.
  • Establish reporting and automation that improves visibility, operating efficiency, and the speed of decision-making.
  • Share learnings across the Growth organization and stay current on platform changes, attribution, AI-enabled marketing, and emerging acquisition strategies.

Qualifications

  • 5-7 years of DTC digital marketing experience, including at least 4 years of hands-on experience across paid social and paid search.
  • Proven experience building and scaling campaigns across Meta Ads, with working experience in TikTok, Google, and YouTube Ads.
  • Experience managing meaningful media budgets and improving acquisition performance through structured testing and optimization.
  • Strong understanding of attribution and revenue reporting, with the ability to connect media investment to customer acquisition, conversion, and revenue.
  • Strong creative instincts and experience translating performance data into actionable briefs, concepts, and testing priorities.
  • Highly analytical and comfortable using Google Analytics and Excel or Google Sheets to identify trends and make informed decisions.
  • Proactive, resourceful, and organized, with the ability to create structure and momentum in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across Growth, Creative, Digital Product, and external agency partners.
  • An AI-forward working style, with experience applying AI to analysis, copy, targeting, testing, or workflow automation.
  • Experience with Triple Whale, Northbeam, Google Data Studio, or Supermetrics is a plus, as is working knowledge of SEO and answer engine optimization.

Our Core Values and what we built our culture around:

  • WE THINK BIG: We have a forward-thinking, growth mindset and always consider the big picture in our decisions
  • PROACTIVE PROBLEM SOLVER: We use our problem-solving and analytical skills to make data-informed decisions
  • WE ARE COMFORTABLE BEING UNCOMFORTABLE: We work together to iron out improvements or changes to achieve goals
  • OPEN & HONEST COMMUNICATION/FEEDBACK: We communicate and share feedback with each other with radical candor and transparency
  • CONTINUOUS LEARNING & IMPROVEMENT: We are always improving the way we work and challenging each other to bring new ways of thinking to the table
  • WE TAKE OWNERSHIP & ACT WITH URGENCY: We take complete accountability for our goals and take swift & effective action to reach them.

Our Company Benefits:

  • $110,000 – $170,000 base salary, commensurate with experience
  • Performance bonus tied to revenue metrics
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Unlimited PTO + paid holidays
  • Remote-first role, with occasional travel required
  • Stipends for fitness, continuous learning, and work-from-home setup
  • Discounts on iRESTORE Products
  • High-visibility role with opportunities for career growth
  • Collaborative, fast-moving team that values initiative and ideas
  • And more!

iRESTORE is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Salary: $110,000 – $170,000 / year

raw.description:
We have begun preparing for the interview process for this position and are only reviewing new candidates at the hiring manager's discretion.

Job Summary

Sports Reference, LLC is searching for a Scrum Master to assist our Agile teams by facilitating and coordinating Agile processes within the engineering department and cross-functional teams. The engineering team currently has 22 team members consisting of developers, testers, DevOps, and Scrum Masters.

We currently serve 20 million (and growing) monthly users on our free, ad-supported Reference Sites (, , , etc.) and , our SaaS offering that provides powerful search and filtering capabilities for deeper exploration of our vast databases. In 2023, we acquired , the viral baseball trivia game, and have since launched ad-supported grid games for basketball, football, hockey, and soccer.

To Apply

Please visit our jobs website at and submit your resume and a cover letter for this position.

We plan to begin the phone interview process the week of August 31st, but may start earlier depending on the volume of applications we receive. Applications arriving after phone interviews begin will be collected, but will receive consideration at the discretion of the hiring manager based on the progress we have made in filling the position. We have provided a general outline of our interview process here:

Our Purpose and Values

We democratize data, so our users enjoy, understand, and share the sports they love.

We value:

  • Respect for our users, the athletes we cover, and our team;
  • Craftsmanship in building tools and products;
  • Reliable tools and services that meet our users' needs every day; and
  • Data democratization. We publish many data sets for emerging and underserved sports. The New York Times covered our recognition of the Negro Leagues as major leagues in the summer of 2021. We added women’s college basketball data to our site in 2023 and now have the only publicly available database of every score in women’s NCAA Division 1 history.

More on our values and history can be found on our about page. To meet these expectations, we encourage team members to participate in company discussions and share new ideas, features or potential solutions to problems.

Background

As a Scrum Master, you will facilitate and coordinate Agile processes within cross-functional teams, ensuring the team can work collaboratively and efficiently to deliver high-quality solutions.

You will work closely with the team to ensure that the work progresses on schedule and to the desired level of quality. Additionally, you will help to foster a culture of continuous improvement and ensuring that the team is meeting its objectives consistently.

This is an entry level position, and Sports Reference will work with you to train your skills on the specifics of the role. This is a position within our engineering department, but no development skills are required.

We are searching for the role of a scrum master, but do not expect Scrum certification for this role. We provide continuing education benefits and would support you earning your Scrum certification.

Goals and Tasks for Your First Year (In rough order of importance)

Must-Reach Goals and Tasks

  • Organize project work in dashboards and project management tooling, and keep the status up to date
  • Help coordinate small to medium sized projects within the company
  • Report status of projects regularly verbally in small meetings, as well as written asynchronous communication when needed
  • Help create small tasks in project management software and assign as appropriate
  • Facilitate meetings (standups, iteration boundary, retros) ranging from 3-45+ people
  • Keep metrics about the status of work that is currently being worked on
  • Continually improve our process by analysis and holding retrospective meetings

Nice-to-Reach Goals and Tasks

  • Manage issues, small features and defects for teams
  • Facilitate demos of completed issues and requests
  • Help understand resourcing constraints for upcoming projects and suggest potential candidates based on skills within the engineering team

Qualifications and Skills

A qualified candidate will satisfy the following:

  • Evidence that you are capable of meeting many of the goals listed above.
  • Have a history of getting things done (and done well).
  • If you don’t think your application will have evidence that you can meet all of the 'nice-to-reach goals and tasks' above but still are interested in the job and otherwise qualify, please apply. Nobody checks every box—we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

Salary

Our salary range starts at $84k for U.S. based employees. We are a remote-first company and determine our pay range for this position based on the market rates for Philadelphia, our home base. The salary offered will be based on your experience and skill level.

Annual bonuses are variable and are tied to a percentage of the company's end of year profits and the employee's time worked and salary earned during the year. In the last three years, they have averaged 15% of an employee’s annual salary.

Benefits

Even though we are a small company, Sports Reference has a generous benefits package.

  • The total value of our benefits package is up to $30,000.
  • We cover full health and dental insurance costs for full-time employees and their dependent children. We cover 70%-80% of plans for an entire family.
  • We have a 401k with a match on your contributions up to 4% of your base salary. The 401k has many low cost investing options.
  • We pay all premiums for company-sponsored life and long-term disability insurance for all employees.
  • We provide up to $7,000/year in continuing education benefits.
  • Even if you live in or near Philly, you have the option to work remotely as much as you choose. We generally work a standard workday, but with flexibility to adjust hours within that framework.
  • Any parent welcoming a new child to their family is entitled to 13 weeks of fully paid leave, and up to an additional 39 weeks at half-time.
  • Employees begin with 18 days of PTO per year and an additional 8 paid company holidays and accrue sick leave at the rate of one day per month.
  • We will generally buy you whatever equipment will make you the most productive.
  • We typically will pay for reasonable moving-related expenses related to your acceptance of a position with Sports Reference. Please ask if you have questions regarding this benefit.
  • We provide a $68/month remote work stipend to cover the cost of internet access and incidental expenses.

Other Information

  • Sports Reference's first site was launched in 2000. We have bootstrapped ourselves to 45 full-time employees and have no venture capital backing.
  • Applicants must have a legal right to work in the United States or Canada. Hiring an employee not based in the US or Canada would be difficult to coordinate at this time.
  • We are willing to provide accommodations for candidates for whom the timing or structure of our interview process may be challenging. This may include early morning or evening interview times or provide payment to cover child care expenses if needed. If you are applying for a role where verbal communication is not a significant requirement, we may consider an alternative form of interview as is reasonably possible and suitable. Similarly, if an extended period of internet connectivity is a challenge, we may consider an alternate form of interview. If we invite you to interview, please let us know of any possibly necessary accommodations.
  • Our typical interview process is described at
  • Sports Reference is a remote-first company. Sports Reference is located in Philadelphia and non-Philadelphia candidates will be considered on an equal footing to those who are local. Presently, all Sports Reference employees are working remotely at least some of the time, but those in the Philly area may work from the office on days of their choosing.
  • This is a full-time position.
  • Employment at Sports Reference LLC is at-will and this position is an at-will appointment.
  • 100% of our merchandise sales support youth sports.

Sports Reference is a growing company, and your work will be highly visible and have a definite and immediate impact (Read about us in the New York Times and The Athletic ($)). We reached over 20 million users each month and served over 2.0 billion pages in 2023.

Sports Reference provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship status, civil union status, color, discrimination, domestic partnership status, domestic violence victim status, familial status, gender, gender expression, gender identity, gender transition, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, marriage to a co-worker, mental or physical disability or illness, military service, military and veteran status, national origin (including physical, cultural, or linguistic characteristics), nationality, parental leave, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding or medical or common conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth), race (including traits that are historically associated with race, such as hair texture and protective hairstyles, including braids, locks and twists), religion, retaliation, sexual harassment, sexual or affectional orientation (actual or perceived, whether or not traditionally associated with the person’s designated sex at birth), status with regard to public assistance, transgender identity, unfavorable discharge of military status (less than “honorable” but not “dishonorable”), or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances, or on the basis of sports franchise preferences.

Salary: $84,000+ / year

You’ll represent a proven, well-established SaaS product - trusted by customers for nearly 30 years - giving you a strong foundation for meaningful conversations with prospects.

This is a role for someone who already knows how to prospect and wants to take it further - refining their approach, testing what works, and consistently delivering results in a structured SaaS environment.

  • generate qualified pipeline for the MAX sales team through structured outbound prospecting (email, LinkedIn, calls)

  • bring 1-3 years of experience in an SDR / BDR or sales role with outbound prospecting
  • feel confident in cold outreach (calls, emails, LinkedIn) and show resilience in handling rejection
  • have experience working with B2B clients, ideally in SaaS, startups, or agencies
  • are familiar with CRM tools, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or other sales automation tools

Salary range:

Extra perks include:

Apply and enjoy our fully remote online recruitment process!

  5. Offer: If you have what it takes, accept our offer and - welcome aboard! Join our team and be in great company!

*To help us review your application, we kindly ask you to submit your CV in English. Thank you!

Michasia is the recruiter responsible for this process - if you have any additional questions, feel free to contact her!
